bug_summary: pq_getmsgbytes/pq_copymsgbytes/pq_getmsgtextが len - cursor を符号なし演算で計算しており、cursor > len (不正なメッセージ)のとき本来ereportすべき所でunderflowしてpanicしていた
pr_title: Align buffer limit error message and simplify pqformat length checks
pr_description: `enlarge_string_info`'s error on exceeding the allocation cap spelled out the byte counts in the message text, whereas the rest of the crate's allocation-limit errors just say "out of memory" and let the `.with_detail(...)` carry the specifics. This aligns the message with that convention and simplifies the remaining-length checks in `pq_getmsgbytes`, `pq_copymsgbytes`, and `pq_getmsgtext` to a plain subtraction instead of `saturating_sub`, along with the matching test update.
